jobs.description:
Your team

The Pictet group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented in 30 offices in financial centres worldwide, currently employing over 4600 people. Pictet has been present in Singapore for more than 30 years where it employs over 200 people.

Pictet Asset Services provides custody, fund services and trading solutions for external asset managers, fund managers and institutional clients. We manage every aspect of the asset servicing value chain and our range of bespoke solutions include value-adding analytics, trading strategy support and digital front-end interfaces designed to provide an unrivalled customer experience.

Your role

This role support and develop Pictet Asset Services B2B client relationships in Asia by combining front-facing relationship management with strong operational and servicing capabilities, acting as a shadow Client Relationship Manager (CRM) while ensuring best-in-class day-to-day support. For the candidate with the appropriate credential and ambition, this position offers a potential pathway to a full CRM role in the future.

Key Responsibilities:

Client Relationship Officer

• Lead with complex account opening/closing, static data changes and onboarding of new services, ensuring completeness and accuracy of documentation.

• Provide daily operational support including but not limited to: processing and monitoring of payments, cash movements, securities orders, fund subscriptions/redemptions, and asset transfers.

• Handle client queries and incidents, ensuring timely resolution, proper escalation and clear communication to clients and internal teams.

• Verify the accuracy of transactions and data input in core banking and PAS tools; maintain up-to-date client files and internal records.

• Contribute to client satisfaction and retention through proactive, solution-oriented servicing and regular contact (calls, emails, meetings).

• Assist in coordinating internal stakeholders (Operations, Legal, Compliance, Credit, Trading, other PAS locations) to deliver a seamless client experience.
Promote collaboration and alignment of processes between Singapore and other PAS hubs (Geneva/Luxembourg).

• Contribute to keeping operating memoranda, procedures and checklists accurate and up to date as processes evolve.

Commercial Support / Relationship Management (Shadow CRM)

• Support senior MH/ CRMs in managing and developing relationships with existing Institutional clients including preparation for meetings and follow-ups.
Help build a comprehensive understanding of clients’ business models, objectives, challenges and decision-making processes.

• Support commercial initiatives (pricing analyses, fee schedules, KPIs, simple profitability views) and preparation of pitch or review materials for existing and prospective clients.

• Identify and flag opportunities for cross-sell / up-sell and process improvements to the CRM and Market Head.

Your profile

Education & Experience
• University degree or equivalent in Finance, Economics, Business or related field.
• 5–7 years’ experience in a Client Relationship Officer / Client Service / middle-office role in asset servicing, custody, or private banking; strong exposure to B2B clients (Asset Managers, Institutional clients, EAMs/GIs).
• Good understanding of banking and asset-servicing products, operational flows and securities / funds processing; knowledge of Avaloq or similar core banking system is an advantage.
• CMFAS / CACS certifications are an advantage.

Technical & Professional Skills
• Solid knowledge of asset-servicing operations: payments, cash sweeping, settlements, corporate actions, account opening and documentation.
• Strong client-facing skills with the ability to explain operational topics clearly and manage sensitive situations diplomatically.
• Good business mindset: able to understand revenue drivers, pricing considerations and commercial priorities.
• High proficiency with MS Office; comfortable working with internal banking systems and reporting tools.
• Excellent command of English; additional Asian language(s) a plus for regional client coverage.

Personal Competencies
• Enthusiastic, proactive and eager to learn, with a genuine interest in progressing towards a CRM role while still embracing hands-on CRO tasks.
• Strong team player able to work closely with colleagues across locations, while also operating independently when required.
• Well-organised, meticulous and able to manage multiple priorities under time pressure, with strong attention to detail and risk awareness.
• Service-oriented, solutions-driven and resilient, with excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

Diversity & Inclusion

Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. We respect all individuals and seek their inclusion in the workplace.

descriptionByLocale.it:
La tua squadra

Il gruppo Pictet è uno dei principali asset manager indipendenti al mondo. Fondato nel 1805 e con sede a Ginevra, in Svizzera, il Gruppo è rappresentato in 30 uffici nei centri finanziari di tutto il mondo, attualmente con oltre 4600 persone. Pictet è presente a Singapore da oltre 30 anni dove impiega oltre 200 persone.

Pictet Asset Services fornisce la custodia, i servizi di fondo e le soluzioni di trading per gli asset manager esterni, i gestori di fondi e i clienti istituzionali. Gestiamo ogni aspetto della catena del valore di manutenzione degli asset e la nostra gamma di soluzioni su misura includono analisi di valore, supporto strategia di trading e interfacce front-end digitali progettate per fornire un'esperienza clienti senza rivali.

Il tuo ruolo

Questo ruolo supporta e sviluppa le relazioni con i clienti di Pictet Asset Services B2B in Asia combinando la gestione dei rapporti front-facing con le forti capacità operative e di assistenza, agendo come un'ombra Client Relationship Manager (CRM) garantendo al contempo il miglior supporto giornaliero. Per il candidato con le credenziali e l'ambizione appropriate, questa posizione offre un percorso potenziale per un ruolo CRM completo in futuro.

Responsabilità chiave:

Responsabile relazioni cliente

• Condurre con l'apertura/chiusura di account complessi, le modifiche statiche dei dati e l'inserimento di nuovi servizi, garantendo la completezza e l'accuratezza della documentazione.

• Fornire supporto operativo giornaliero, compreso ma non limitato a: elaborazione e monitoraggio dei pagamenti, movimenti di cassa, ordini di titoli, abbonamenti di fondo/rimblazioni e trasferimenti di asset.

• Gestisci le richieste e gli incidenti dei clienti, assicurando una risoluzione tempestiva, una corretta escalation e una comunicazione chiara ai clienti e alle squadre interne.

• Verificare l'accuratezza delle transazioni e dell'ingresso dei dati negli strumenti di core banking e PAS; mantenere i file client aggiornati e i record interni.

• Contribuisci alla soddisfazione e alla ritenzione del cliente attraverso un servizio proattivo, orientato alla soluzione e un contatto regolare (call, email, riunioni).

• Assistere nel coordinamento delle parti interessate interne (Operazioni, Legale, Compliance, Credito, Trading, altre sedi PAS) per offrire un'esperienza client senza soluzione di continuità.
Promuovere la collaborazione e l'allineamento dei processi tra Singapore e altri hub PAS (Geneva/Lussemburgo).

• Contribuire a mantenere la memoranda operativa, procedure e liste di controllo accurate e aggiornate come i processi si evolvono.

Supporto commerciale / Gestione delle relazioni (Shadow CRM)

• Sostenere gli MH/CRM senior nella gestione e nello sviluppo dei rapporti con i clienti istituzionali esistenti, compresa la preparazione di riunioni e follow-up.
Aiuta a costruire una comprensione completa dei modelli aziendali dei clienti, obiettivi, sfide e processi decisionali.

• Sostenere le iniziative commerciali (analisi di partenza, programmi di pagamento, KPI, semplici opinioni sulla redditività) e la preparazione di materiali di pitch o review per i clienti esistenti e potenziali.

• Identificare e contrassegnare le opportunità per il cross-sell / up-sell e migliorare il processo al CRM e Market Head.

Il tuo profilo

Istruzione e esperienza
• Laurea o equivalente in Finanza, Economia, Business o campo relativo.
• Esperienza di 5–7 anni in un Customer Relationship Officer / Servizio Clienti / ruolo di middle-office nella manutenzione degli asset, custodia o private banking; forte esposizione ai clienti B2B (Asset Manager, clienti istituzionali, EAM/GIs).
• Una buona comprensione dei prodotti bancari e di asset-servicing, flussi operativi e elaborazione di titoli / fondi; la conoscenza di Avaloq o simile sistema core banking è un vantaggio.
• Le certificazioni CMFAS / CACS sono un vantaggio.

Competenze tecniche e professionali
• Conoscenza solida delle operazioni di asset-servicing: pagamenti, cash spazzamento, insediamenti, azioni aziendali, apertura del conto e documentazione.
• Forte capacità di affrontare il cliente con la capacità di spiegare chiaramente gli argomenti operativi e gestire situazioni sensibili diplomaticamente.
• Good business mindset: in grado di comprendere i driver di reddito, considerazioni sui prezzi e priorità commerciali.
• Alta competenza con MS Office; lavoro confortevole con sistemi bancari interni e strumenti di reporting.
• Ottimo comando dell'inglese; lingua asiatica aggiuntiva (s) un plus per la copertura clienti regionale.

Competenze personali
• Espressivi, proattivi e desiderosi di imparare, con un autentico interesse a progredire verso un ruolo di CRM, mentre ancora abbracciando i compiti di CRO.
• Forte giocatore di squadra in grado di lavorare a stretto contatto con i colleghi in tutte le posizioni, mentre funziona anche indipendentemente quando richiesto.
• Ben organizzato, meticoloso e in grado di gestire più priorità sotto pressione temporale, con una forte attenzione ai dettagli e alla consapevolezza del rischio.
• Service-oriented, soluzioni-driven e resiliente, con eccellente comunicazione e competenze interpersonali.

Diversità e inclusione

Pictet è un datore di lavoro pari opportunità e si impegna a creare un ambiente diverso. Rispettiamo tutti gli individui e cerchiamo la loro inclusione sul posto di lavoro.

Dein Team

Die Pictet-Gruppe ist einer der weltweit führenden unabhängigen Vermögensverwalter. Die 1805 gegründete Gruppe mit Hauptsitz in Genf, Schweiz, ist in 30 Büros in Finanzzentren weltweit vertreten und beschäftigt derzeit über 4600 Mitarbeiter. Pictet ist seit mehr als 30 Jahren in Singapur präsent und beschäftigt dort über 200 Mitarbeiter.

Pictet Asset Services bietet Depot-, Fondsdienstleistungen und Handelslösungen für externe Vermögensverwalter, Fondsmanager und institutionelle Kunden. Wir verwalten jeden Aspekt der Wertschöpfungskette des Asset Service und unser Sortiment an maßgeschneiderten Lösungen umfasst wertschöpfende Analysen, Unterstützung der Handelsstrategie und digitale Front-End-Schnittstellen, die ein konkurrenzloses Kundenerlebnis bieten.

Deine Rolle

Diese Rolle unterstützt und entwickelt die B2B-Kundenbeziehungen von Pictet Asset Services in Asien, indem sie ein nach vorne gerichtetes Beziehungsmanagement mit starken operativen und Servicefunktionen kombiniert, als Schatten-Client Relationship Manager (CRM) agiert und gleichzeitig einen erstklassigen täglichen Support gewährleistet. Für den Kandidaten mit dem entsprechenden Nachweis und Ehrgeiz bietet diese Position einen potenziellen Weg zu einer vollen CRM-Rolle in der Zukunft.

Wichtigste Aufgaben:

Client Relationship Officer

• Führen Sie mit komplexer Kontoeröffnung / -schließung, statischen Datenänderungen und der Einführung neuer Dienste, um die Vollständigkeit und Genauigkeit der Dokumentation zu gewährleisten.

• Bereitstellung täglicher operativer Unterstützung, einschließlich, aber nicht beschränkt auf: Verarbeitung und Überwachung von Zahlungen, Bargeldbewegungen, Wertpapieraufträgen, Zeichnungen/Rücknahmen von Fonds und Übertragungen von Vermögenswerten.

• Bearbeitung von Kundenanfragen und -vorfällen, um eine rechtzeitige Lösung, eine angemessene Eskalation und eine klare Kommunikation mit Kunden und internen Teams zu gewährleisten.

• Überprüfen Sie die Richtigkeit der Transaktionen und Dateneingaben in Kernbanking- und PAS-Tools; pflegen Sie aktuelle Kundendateien und interne Aufzeichnungen.

• Tragen Sie zur Kundenzufriedenheit und -bindung durch proaktives, lösungsorientiertes Service und regelmäßigen Kontakt (Anrufe, E-Mails, Meetings) bei.

• Unterstützung bei der Koordination interner Stakeholder (Operations, Legal, Compliance, Credit, Trading, andere PAS-Standorte), um ein nahtloses Kundenerlebnis zu bieten.
Förderung der Zusammenarbeit und Abstimmung der Prozesse zwischen Singapur und anderen PAS-Hubs (Genf/Luxemburg).

• Tragen Sie dazu bei, dass Betriebsmemoranden, Verfahren und Checklisten im Laufe der Prozesse korrekt und aktuell sind.

Commercial Support / Relationship Management (Shadow CRM)

• Unterstützen Sie leitende MH / CRMs bei der Verwaltung und Entwicklung von Beziehungen zu bestehenden institutionellen Kunden, einschließlich der Vorbereitung auf Meetings und Folgemaßnahmen.
Helfen Sie dabei, ein umfassendes Verständnis der Geschäftsmodelle, Ziele, Herausforderungen und Entscheidungsprozesse der Kunden aufzubauen.

• Unterstützung kommerzieller Initiativen (Preisanalysen, Gebührenpläne, KPIs, einfache Rentabilitätsansichten) und Vorbereitung von Pitch- oder Review-Materialien für bestehende und potenzielle Kunden.

• Identifizieren und markieren Sie Möglichkeiten für Cross-Selling / Up-Selling und Prozessverbesserungen für den CRM und Market Head.

Dein Profil

Bildung & Erfahrung
• Universitätsabschluss oder gleichwertig in Finanzen, Wirtschaft, Business oder verwandten Bereichen.
• 5-7 Jahre Erfahrung in einem Client Relationship Officer / Client Service / Middle-Office-Rolle in Asset Service, Depot oder Private Banking; starkes Engagement bei B2B-Kunden (Asset Manager, Institutionelle Kunden, EAMs / GIs).
• Gutes Verständnis von Bank- und Asset-Servicing-Produkten, operativen Strömen und Wertpapier- / Fondsverarbeitung; Kenntnisse des Avaloq oder eines ähnlichen Kernbankensystems sind von Vorteil.
• CMFAS / CACS-Zertifizierungen sind von Vorteil.

Technische und berufliche Fähigkeiten
• Solides Wissen über Asset-Servicing-Operationen: Zahlungen, Cash Sweeping, Abwicklungen, Kapitalmaßnahmen, Kontoeröffnung und Dokumentation.
• Starke kundenorientierte Fähigkeiten mit der Fähigkeit, operative Themen klar zu erklären und sensible Situationen diplomatisch zu bewältigen.
• Good Business Mindset: in der Lage, Umsatztreiber, Preisüberlegungen und kommerzielle Prioritäten zu verstehen.
• Hohe Kenntnisse mit MS Office; komfortables Arbeiten mit internen Banksystemen und Reporting-Tools.
• Ausgezeichnete Englischkenntnisse; zusätzliche asiatische Sprache(n) ein Plus für die regionale Kundenabdeckung.

Persönliche Kompetenzen
• Enthusiastisch, proaktiv und lernbegierig, mit einem echten Interesse daran, auf eine CRM-Rolle hinzuarbeiten und gleichzeitig praktische CRO-Aufgaben zu übernehmen.
• Starker Teamplayer, der standortübergreifend eng mit Kollegen zusammenarbeiten und bei Bedarf auch unabhängig arbeiten kann.
• Gut organisiert, sorgfältig und in der Lage, mehrere Prioritäten unter Zeitdruck zu verwalten, mit großer Aufmerksamkeit für Details und Risikobewusstsein.

jobs.description:
Your team

The Pictet group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented in 30 offices in financial centres worldwide, currently employing over 4600 people. Pictet has been present in Singapore for more than 30 years where it employs over 200 people.

Pictet Alternative Advisors (PAA) is a leading alternative investment specialist with expertise in hedge funds, private equity and global real estate. The Geneva and London-based team constructs, manages and advises on portfolios of alternative investment solutions for institutional and private clients.

Your role

You will be a key member of Pictet’s alternatives platform in Asia, acting as a key product and investment expert for our private equity, real estate, hedge fund and broader private markets offering. You will partner closely with senior client‑facing teams to design, position and implement high‑conviction, bespoke alternative investment solutions for sophisticated private and institutional clients across the region.

Client marketing, pitching and portfolio design

• Lead the preparation and delivery of high‑impact pitches and marketing materials for alternative investment opportunities (new funds, switch ideas, co‑investments, portfolio solutions).

• Draft clear, compelling client communications on new Private Equity (PE)/ Real Estate (RE)/ Hedge Funds (HF) opportunities, corporate actions and implementation options.

• Take an active role in client meetings (in person and virtually), confidently articulating strategies, structures and portfolio allocations across PE/RE/HFs.

• Build differentiated portfolio proposals, including back tests, simulations and customized presentations for strategic prospects and existing relationships.

Client reporting and reviews

• Prepare high‑quality monthly and quarterly client reports, including fund‑level commentaries, performance and risk analysis, and portfolio review packs.

• Support strategic relationships by co‑leading or joining PWM Relationship Managers (RM)/ Investment Specialists (IS) in review meetings with top‑tier UHNW and institutional clients.

Client queries and mandate management

• Serve as a primary point of contact for mandate‑related queries across booked alternative investment mandates, ensuring timely and high‑quality responses.

Ce rôle relève du chef de cabinet, Ressources humaines.

Votre rôle

Soutenir l'évolution et l'ambition des RH et des entreprises au moyen d'analyses avancées et d'IA, en fournissant des informations concrètes qui stimulent les décisions stratégiques des personnes et débloquent la valeur organisationnelle. Traduire des données sur les personnes complexes en données pratiques qui appuient des stratégies efficaces d'affaires et de RH, permettant aux RH d'anticiper et de comprendre les principales tendances de la main-d'oeuvre – comme le roulement, le rendement, la rémunération et l'engagement – en tirant parti des dernières données scientifiques. Favoriser une culture dans laquelle les connaissances fondées sur les données informent et améliorent tous les aspects de l'expérience des employés et de l'efficacité organisationnelle. • Élaborer et communiquer une vision claire pour faire progresser la fonction RH vers une culture axée sur les données et axée sur les idées. • Gérer une petite équipe, hiérarchiser et examiner les demandes, équilibrer la charge de travail et assurer un encadrement actif pour renforcer les compétences et les capacités.

Your team

Founded in Geneva in 1805, the Pictet Group is now one of the main independent players in wealth management and asset management in Europe, with funds under management and in deposits exceeding EUR 878 billion at the end of June 2026. It is run by seven partners, who are both owners and managers.

Pictet Asset Management (Pictet AM) is dedicated to managing assets on behalf of third parties through the management of mandates and investment funds. Present in 18 financial centres around the world and employing more than 1100 employees, Pictet AM has been working to deliver an excellent service to a leading professional and institutional clientele since 1980.

This course will allow you to acquire an overall vision of the ecosystem of asset management and develop a good understanding of the different investment strategies and economic and financial news. You will also develop your business skills, synthesis and marketing creativity, while working daily on a dynamic and international team.

Your role

Within Pictet AM's commercial and marketing team, based in Paris, you will assist the team as follows:

Trade missions (60%)

• Support of the commercial team in the maintenance of the customer relationship (institutional, wholesale, and retail clients) in the process of selling Pictet funds (emerging, thematic, bond, alternative and ETF funds).

• Translation and adaptation of management points and investment content Pictet.

• Preparation and updating of commercial media (PowerPoint, e-mails, newsletters, product presentations).

• Response to client questionnaires or requests (telephone or e-mail).

• Organization and logistics at customer events.

• Writing of summaries in French of technical content received from management teams.

Marketing missions (40%):

• Creation and programming of emailing campaigns.

• Dissemination and programming of communications on the investment funds and the macroeconomic views of Pictet AM.

• Online and updated content on our websites and those of our partners.

• Organization and logistics of customer events.

• Participation in the creation of audio and video content: monitoring, preparation, recording and editing.

• Drafting and adapting content on funds according to current market developments.

• Maintenance and maintenance of the client database.

Your daily life will be varied, interesting and punctuated by projects at different times as well as some recurring missions, requiring an excellent sense of organisation and management of priorities.
